//: cleanUrls replaces the four rewrites that used to point every route at
/index.html. Each route is now its own file, generated from index.html by
tools/build-routes.mjs, so /projects serves projects.html with ITS OWN
title, description and canonical rather than the homepage's. The rewrites
made all five URLs byte-identical, which told Google four of them were
duplicates of / and left the site with one indexable page.
cleanUrls also 308s /projects.html to /projects, so the .html spelling
cannot become a second URL for the same content.
